items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: He was the trumpet player of the wild too. Yeah. See, uh, Lois, when Lois come off of the boat, well, he took, uh, Lois Humphrey his place. Yeah. Lois Humphrey was there before Lois.

ctx.x: Nicholas, I think, played up at the Tom Anderson's, didn't he? Yeah, with Lois Humphrey.
And Lois Humphrey. And Lois Humphrey. And Lois Humphrey, I think, was the trumpet player of the wild too.
